title: Intel reveals that Xeon 7, aimed at HPC and debuting in 2027, will support up to 256 cores and 22 chiplets, with 16 built on its bleeding-edge 18A-P process (Tobias Mann/The Register)

contentText:
Tobias Mann / The Register :

Intel reveals that Xeon 7, aimed at HPC and debuting in 2027, will support up to 256 cores and 22 chiplets, with 16 built on its bleeding-edge 18A-P process   —  Delayed, flawed, yet still beautiful  —  DEEP DIVE Intel's Xeon 7 platform, better known by its codename Diamond Rapids …
